events.title: Diana Velazquez Dissertation Defense
events.summary: This dissertation defense explores how lake sediments serve as archives of environmental change, preserving geochemical signals linked to shifts in biogeochemical cycling. The research investigates organic matter burial and preservation in modern and ancient hypoxic aquatic environments, offering insights into carbon cycling and past environmental conditions.
